Article 5 (Transitional Measures concerning Retrial Cases)
(1) Articles 2 through 4 shall apply mutatis mutandis to retrial cases that are pending. In such cases, the Commissioner of the Korean Intellectual Property Office shall attach both the appellate trial documents and the retrial documents when forwarding documents under Article 2 (1).
(2) Where a petition for retrial is filed with the Patent Court after these Rules enter into force against a final appellate trial decision of the Appellate Trial Office on a trial decision, the Patent Court shall promptly notify the President of the Intellectual Property Tribunal thereof; upon receipt of that notice, the President of the Intellectual Property Tribunal shall promptly forward the appellate trial documents concerning the case to the Patent Court.
